401 Unauthorized when creating a batch with invalid API key

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.create_batch_async(LiterLlm::CreateBatchRequest.new(completion_window: '24h', endpoint: '/v1/chat/completions', input_file_id: 'file-abc123'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
